snippet.title: Project Kouvola - FINAL TRAILER 5: "This is your Story" | [ENG]
snippet.description:
THE GATES ARE FINALLY OPEN
WELCOME TO THE DISTOPIAN FINLAND 

Project Kouvola is finally available everywhere!!

And when I say everywhere, I mean it!
Windows, Mac, Linux/SteamDeck, it doesn't matter!

Play the first chapter for free on itch.io or buy it on Steam to support the development of the remaining two chapters!
(Harmony in Disaster will be included for free in a future update if you buy it on Steam.)

This is your story, but at the same time, this is a dream come true for me.
Thank you very much for all your support. I hope you can stay with us for many years to come.

That's all we have for today, so, again... thank you for everything, and we hope you have a happy holiday season!!!


Made with Love by: LowMoon [Al3x] & The Yukimi GS Team 💜 

Nocturne Op. 9, No. 2 Original Cover by Lai: https://youtu.be/fqiIyxEOQWM?si=2ysuvkFIt1uuLrN9

itch.io: https://lowmoondev.itch.io/project-kouvola
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3908770/Project_Kouvola/
Twitter: https://x.com/LowMoonDev
